usedFor: Mini Course Generator holds learners and completions, and Sangam CRM receives leads through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Course Completed” in Mini Course Generator, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A finished course shows interest, and the action adds or updates the lead.

watchOut: “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM matches by ID, email or phone, so learners need at least one.
